publication_name: Machinery orders, private demand excluding ships and electric power, nominal million yen, seasonally adjusted, calendar month
access_description: The catalogue page links one current chouki-1 workbook. No API key. The filename changes with the release. Only sheet 季調・月次, column J, is read.
conditions: Cite the Cabinet Office and the catalogue URL. Do not present an edited figure as an unedited official figure. This row is nominal million yen, seasonally adjusted, calendar month. It is not the fiscal-year sheet and not a real volume index.
revision_behaviour: The workbook is the current long series, not a historical vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero.
unresolved_questions: The terms do not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. One current workbook cannot reconstruct vintages from before they are collected.
evidence_note: Assessed 2026-10-24. Cabinet Office terms at https://www.cao.go.jp/notice/rule.html state: 当ウェブサイトで公開している情報（以下「コンテンツ」という。）の著作権は、特記されていない限り内閣府に帰属し、権利表記の記載がない限り公共データ利用規約（第1.0版）（デジタル庁）が適用されます。 Machinery orders are not in the list of content under a different rule. Public Data Licence 1.0 at https://www.digital.go.jp/resources/open_data/public_data_license_v1.0 states that anyone may reproduce, publicly transmit, and adapt the content, and: 商用利用も可能です。 数値データ、簡単な表・グラフ等は著作権による保護の対象ではありませんので、これらについては本利用ルールの適用はなく、自由に利用できます。 The workbook is published by the Economic and Social Research Institute, Cabinet Office. The bound sheet is 季調・月次, column J, private demand excluding ships and electric power (船舶・電力を除く), unit (単位:100万円). It is nominal, not a real volume index, seasonally adjusted, and a calendar month. The sheet 年度・暦年 is not read, so fiscal-year and calendar-year totals are not this series. A non-persisting read on 2026-10-24 of the catalogue link 2026/2608chouki-1.xlsx showed monthly rows from April 2005 through August 2026 on that sheet. The workbook is latest-revised, not a historical vintage panel. includeHistory is not requested. No secret is used. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000.
